newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ridley sees continued profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ridley sees continued profit growth.

text.p: Stock feed group Ridley Corporation Ltd said on Monday said it was optimistic of achieving another record performance in the 1996/97 (June-July) financial year.

Earlier the company reported a 14.3 percent higher record pre-tax operating profit of A$36.28 million although net profit was only marginally up at A$22.36 million from A$21.43 in the previous corresponding year.
In a statement accompanying the results, the company said growth prospects remain promising with sales and profit growth expected to continue across all businesses in the current year.
Locally, the company said demand from the dairy, pig and poultry sectors would keep growing but the troubled beef sector was not expected to recover in the short term.
Expanded feed mill capacity in Australia and Canada was seen giving further productivty boosts and reduced operating costs.
Ridley said the outlook for wheat and coarse grain prices remained highly volatile while world stocks were low with high prices and limited supply expected to maintain pressure on profit margins.

The outlook for Canadian grain prices was also seen as uncertain with profit growth unlikely to match growth in sales volume although continued growth in market share was expected in the dairy, pig and poultry sectors.
Ridley shares closed three cents lower at A$1.63 on turnover of 59,565 shares.
